period.id: Seleksi 2027/2028 sudah selesai; pengumuman 30 Oktober 2026 dan daftar ulang (pertemuan wajib orang tua) 31 Oktober 2026.
period.en: Selection for 2027/2028 is finished; results on 30 October 2026 and re-registration (mandatory parents' meeting) on 31 October 2026.

steps.id: Pendaftaran online dan tes akademik di sekolah.
steps.en: Online registration and an academic test at the school.

steps.id: Orang tua calon murid yang diterima wajib hadir sendiri (tidak boleh diwakilkan) untuk daftar ulang; yang tidak hadir dianggap mengundurkan diri.
steps.en: Parents of accepted students must attend in person for re-registration; absence counts as withdrawal.

notes.en: Fees are not published on the site.

source.title: Pengumuman Penerimaan Peserta Didik Baru 2027/2028 — SMA Kolese Gonzaga (situs resmi)
